title: Faithful, Sufficient and Understandable: Rethinking Graph Counterfactual Explanations via Discrete Diffusion Inversion
abstract: arXiv:2608.12083v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on graph-structured data across domains such as chemistry, biology, and network analysis, yet they provide no intrinsic explanation of their predictions. This limits their adoption in high-stakes and safety-critical settings. Counterfactual explanations address this by revealing the minimal structural modifications that would change a model's prediction. On graphs, however, such a modification is hard to produce. The search space is discrete and combinatorial, and a valid answer must respect categorical node and edge types together with domain rules such as chemical valency in the case of molecular graphs. Existing explainers give up one of two things. Either edits are not held on the data manifold, or the search does not span the full edit space. translated_title: 忠实、充分且可理解：通过离散扩散反演重新思考图反事实解释
translated_abstract: 摘要：图神经网络（GNNs）在化学、生物学和网络分析等领域中的图结构数据上取得了强大的预测性能，但它们对其预测结果没有提供内在的解释。这限制了它们在高风险和安全关键场景中的应用。反事实解释通过揭示改变模型预测所需的最小结构修改来解决这一问题。然而，在图结构上，这种修改很难生成。搜索空间是离散且组合性的，有效的答案必须尊重类别化的节点和边类型以及领域规则（例如分子图中的化学价态）。现有的解释器要么放弃其中一点：要么编辑不保持在数据流形上，要么搜索不覆盖完整的编辑空间。我们提出了通过反演的图扩散反事实解释（GDCE-I），该方法两者都不放弃。一个离散的去噪扩散过程被用于生成反事实编辑，确保修改既忠实于数据分布，又充分探索编辑空间，同时生成的解释保持可理解性。
tldr: 本文提出GDCE-I方法，通过离散扩散反演生成反事实解释，同时保持数据流形一致性和完整编辑空间探索，实现忠实、充分且可理解的图解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GDCE-I, a discrete diffusion inversion method for counterfactual explanations on graphs, achieving faithful, sufficient, and understandable edits by maintaining data manifold consistency and full edit space exploration.
